title: Data-Minning
summary: A student data mining coursework repository containing a crypto price/sentiment analysis project. Its data_builder.py script uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with a SingleTableMetadata object to generate synthetic sentiment data to fill in a dataset alongside real crypto price data.
evidence: Crypto_Project/scripts/data_builder.py:31-35: metadata = SingleTableMetadata(); synthesizer = GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata); synthesizer.fit(...); synthesizer.sample(...)
needs: No README; authorship and institutional affiliation unknown despite academic-looking coursework context.
